temporal_state_chain.observed: Ethan notices Gary working excessively long hours, skipping meals, and sacrificing sleep. He invites Gary to a weekend retreat, but Gary appreciates the concern and refuses, saying there is too much to do at the hospital.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Gary is overworking at the hospital and harming his health; Ethan believes Gary needs rest and that a weekend retreat could help him.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes—Gary's refusal shows he is not ready or able to step away from work despite Ethan's concern.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Gary remains heavily committed to hospital work and resistant to taking a break; his health may still be at risk.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To keep looking for ways to support Gary and help him address his overwork without forcing him.

temporal_state_chain.observed: At the retreat, Ethan observes Gary's restless behavior and avoidance of discussions about work. When Ethan confronts him, Gary says it is complicated and that he did not want to burden Ethan.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Gary is under work-related stress, but his recent behavior suggests there may be more going on than ordinary professional obligations.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes—Gary's response confirms that there is a deeper, complicated issue, and that Gary has been withholding it to avoid burdening Ethan.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Gary is facing something more than routine work stress and feels unable or unwilling to share it; Ethan should offer nonjudgmental support.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To get Gary to open up and reassure him that he can share what is happening without being judged.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Gary opens up about the pressures of managing a new department and the personal challenges he is facing. Ethan responds by suggesting they prioritize tasks and delegate responsibilities.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Gary has a deeper personal problem he has been hiding because he does not want to burden Ethan.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes—the specific causes are now clear: work pressures from managing a new department plus personal challenges.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Gary's overwork is driven by identifiable work and personal pressures; with help organizing tasks and delegating, he may find a better balance.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To help Gary prioritize and delegate so he can balance responsibilities and make time for himself.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Over the following months, Ethan regularly checks in with Gary. Gary reports that things are better, he is not as overwhelmed, and he even had time for a movie last weekend.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Gary is trying to improve his work-life balance with Ethan's support, but he still faces challenges.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes—Gary's reports and efforts confirm that he is making real progress and benefiting from the support.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Gary is improving, is capable of change, and benefits from continued encouragement.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To continue offering support, encouragement, and regular check-ins.

temporal_state_chain.observed: After a year, Gary has successfully adjusted to a healthier work-life balance, feels more in control, and thanks Ethan for his support.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Gary has been improving and may still need support or encouragement.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes—Gary is now managing independently and has achieved a healthier balance.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Gary is capable of managing on his own; Ethan can step back while remaining available if needed.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To step back from active support but let Gary know he is always available if needed.
